description: This file defines interfaces for built-in JSON-RPC methods related to the Thunder framework, including version retrieval, method existence checks, and event registration.

classes.name: IServiceBuiltIns
classes.description: Interface for retrieving JSON-RPC service interface versions.

classes.name: IInterfaceBuiltIns
classes.description: Interface for checking existence of JSON-RPC methods or properties.

classes.name: IInterfaceWithEventsBuiltIns
classes.description: Interface for registering and unregistering for JSON-RPC notifications.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JSON-RPC interfaces offered by the service.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific JSON-RPC method or property exists.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers for an asynchronous JSON-RPC notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters from an asynchronous JSON-RPC notification.
